name: San Saba County, TX
findings: San Saba County has 43 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Saba County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in San Saba County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 77% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
